versions.subject: Create proc_creation_win_wab_execution_from_non_default_location.yml
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\wab.exe'
filter:
    Image|startswith:
        - 'C:\Windows\WinSxS\'
        - 'C:\Program Files\Windows Mail\'
        - 'C:\Program Files (x86)\Windows Mail\'
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: Image="*\\wab.exe" NOT (Image IN ("C:\\Windows\\WinSxS\\*", "C:\\Program Files\\Windows Mail\\*", "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Windows Mail\\*"))
